cat > /root/prism_collapse_mixing/run_pipeline.sh << 'BASH_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

PARQUET_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/fineweb_data"
mkdir -p "$PARQUET_DIR"

FILE_014="$PARQUET_DIR/014_00000.parquet"
FILE_000="$PARQUET_DIR/000_00000.parquet"
TARGET_SIZE_014=575038542
TARGET_SIZE_000=2147311840

# Wait for 014 to finish downloading
echo "$(date): Waiting for 014_00000.parquet download..."
while true; do
    if [ -f "$FILE_014" ]; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_014" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_014" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 014_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        fi
        echo "$(date): 014 progress: $SIZE / $TARGET_SIZE_014 bytes"
    fi
    sleep 10
done

# Kill old 000 wget if still stuck, restart it
pkill -f "wget.*000_00000" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2

echo "$(date): Starting 000_00000.parquet download..."
wget --continue -O "$FILE_000" \
    "https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb/resolve/main/sample/10BT/000_00000.parquet" \
    > /tmp/wget_000_v2.log 2>&1 &
WGET_PID=$!
echo "$(date): wget PID=$WGET_PID"

# Process probe+val while 000 downloads
echo "$(date): Processing probe+val from 014..."
python3 /root/prism_collapse_mixing/prepare_data.py --phase1-only 2>&1 || {
    echo "$(date): Phase 1 failed, trying full run..."
}

# Wait for 000 download
echo "$(date): Waiting for 000_00000.parquet download..."
while true; do
    if [ -f "$FILE_000" ]; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_000" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_000" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 000_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        fi
        PCTG=$((SIZE * 100 / TARGET_SIZE_000))
        echo "$(date): 000 progress: ${PCTG}% ($SIZE / $TARGET_SIZE_000 bytes)"
    fi
    # Check if wget is still running
    if ! ps -p $WGET_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_000" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_000" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 000_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        else
            echo "$(date): ERROR: wget died but file incomplete ($SIZE bytes). Retrying..."
            wget --continue -O "$FILE_000" \
                "https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb/resolve/main/sample/10BT/000_00000.parquet" \
                > /tmp/wget_000_v2.log 2>&1 &
            WGET_PID=$!
        fi
    fi
    sleep 30
done

# Process train
echo "$(date): Processing train from 000..."
python3 /root/prism_collapse_mixing/prepare_data.py 2>&1

echo "$(date): Pipeline complete!"
BASH_EOF
chmod +x /root/prism_collapse_mixing/run_pipeline.sh
echo "Pipeline script written OK"
